DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 67 s. 2022 JUL 25 2022 MANUEL G. GUANZON Punong Barangay Capitol Site, Cebu City Dear PB Guanzon: This has reference to your letter-query dated May IO, 2022 requesting for legal opinion on whether a Gender and DevelopmenV GAD Focal Point Person is a non- mandatory position and whether it is legal to decrease the salary allotted to its personnel. As represented in the subject letter and its attachments, the Barangay Treasurer of herein concerned barangay received an order from one (I) Sangguniang Barangay member to cease in the preparation of the 2022 Barangay Annual Budget after the latter's final review finding out that the Gender Awareness Development (GAD), a "non- mandatory" position, receives higher honoraria compared to the incumbent Sangguniang Barangay members and the two (2) appointed Barangay Officials (Secretary and Treasurer). Under such premise, arose your queries. On the "mandatoriness" of GAD position, attention is respectfully directed to Section 36 (b) of Republic Act (RA) No. 9710 or the Magna Carta of Women, thus: "Section 36. Xxx All departments, including their attached agencies, offices, bureaus, state universities and colleges, government-owned and -controlled corporations, local government units, and other government instrumentalities shall adopt gender mainstreaming as a strategy to promote women's human rights and eliminate gender discrimination in their systems, structures, policies, programs, processes, and procedures which shall include, but not limited to, the following: (a) xxx (b) Creation and/or Strengthening of the GAD Focal Points (GFP). All departments, including their attached agencies, offices, bureaus, state universities and colleges, government- owned and -controlled corporations, local government units, and other government instrumentalities shall establish or strengthen their GAD Focal Point Svstem or similar GAD mechanism to catalyze and accelerate gender mainstreaming within the agency or local government unit. Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

The GAD Focal Point System shall be composed of the agency head or local chief executive, an executive committee with an Undersecretary (or its equivalent), local government unit official, or office in a strategic decision- making position as Chair; and a technical working group or secretariat which is composed of representatives from various divisions or offices within the agency or local government unit. The tasks and functions of the members of the GFP shall form part of their regular key result areas and shall be given due consideration in their performance evaluation." (Emphasis Supplied) Based on the aforequoted provision, it can be deduced that what is expressly mandated by law is the creation of a GAD Focal Point System (GFPS), and not necessarily a GAD position or GAP Focal Person. Here, it is worthy to note that GFPS is a confluence of three (3) groups namely; the Executive Committee, the Technical Working Group and the Secretariat— each has their own functions pursuant to the Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of RA No. 9710 (Magna Carta of Women). In the local government context, the composition and the roles of GFPS is detailed in PCW-DILG-DBM-NEDA Joint Memorandum Circular (JMC) No. 2013-01 (Guidelines on the Localization of the Magna Carta of Women) as amended. It is worthy to note that the responsibility of promoting and ensuring that GAD is mainstreamed in local policy-making, planning, programming, budgeting, implementation, monitoring and evaluation is a tremendous task, so much so that it is lodged with interdependent group working in tandem. Had it been the intention of the legislature to lodge such task to one (1) single person it could expressly have provided in the law the mandatory creation or appointment of a GAD Focal Person instead of GAD Focal Point System. Corallarily, Item 4.1 (A) of PCW-DILG-DBM-NEDA JMC No. 2013-01 provides for the creation of LGU GFPS and its composition. In the case of barangays, Item 4.1 (A) (2) provides that: "A. Creation and/or Strengthening of the LGU GAD Focal Point System (GFPS) The Barangay GFPS shall be chaired by the Punong Barangay, co-chaired by the Chair of the Sangguniang Barangay Committee on Women, Children and Family, with the following as members: Sangguniang Barangay Committee on Appropriations ii. SK Chairperson Barangay Health Worker iii. iv. Barangay Treasurer Violence Against Women (VAW) Desk Officer v. Barangay Nutrition Scholar vi. vii. Tanod Executive Officer viii. Day Care Worker ix. Lupong Tagapamayapa member x. Women's organizations existing at the barangay level xi. Barangay Human Rights Action Officer, where existent xii. Members of the private sector and academe, as appropriate The Barangay Secretary shall provide secretariat support to the Barangay GFPS." Page 2 of 3

Notwithstanding, this Department is of the view that barangays may create GAD position pursuant to Section 387 of the Local Government Codel provided there is an ordinance duly enacted by the sanggunian sanctioning the same. In fact, Item 4.2 (2) of the aforesaid JMC provides that "Where feasible, the LGU also establish a GAD Office or unit under the Office of the LCE that will support and coordinate all GAD-related PPAs and concerns of the LGU GFPS. The LCE also appoint or designate the LGU personnel to manage the GAD office and/or unit." As to the second query, Item 4.2.2 of the Local Budget Circular No. 145 dated March 2, 2022, issued by the Department of Budget and Management is instructive, thus: "Provisions for actual salaried of incumbent personnel occupying regular positions that were properly granted pursuant to the implementation of R.A. No. 6758, as amended, shall be prioritized. There shall be no reduction in the actual salaries and other salary-based benefit (e.g., Mid-year Bonus, Year-End Bonus) of incumbent personnel occupying regular positions for purposes of complying with the PS limitation." (Emphasis supplied) This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, By the Authority of the Secretary: M LO ndersec a or Local Government OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/jam Dir. LEOCADIO T.
